Attached is Addendum No.1 to the Contract Documents

Per the Contract Documents, all bidders shall acknowledge receipt of this addendum by printing their company name, date, and name of an authorized representative in the spaces provided below, signing this sheet and returning it to Gale Associates, Inc. either by fax at 603-471-1809 or else by email to sam@gainc.com by no later than 1:00 p.m. on Wednesday, February 21, 2018.
If you do not receive the number of pages specified, please contact the sender.
GARDNER MUNICIPAL AIRPORT CONSTRUCT T-HANGARS AIP NO. 3-25-0020-XXX-2018 (Pending)

The attention of all bidders submitting proposals for the above project is called to the following changes to the Contract Documents. The items set forth herein, whether of clarification, omission, addition, or substitution are to be included in and shall form a part of the proposal submitted.

Bidders shall acknowledge receipt of the Addendum by writing the words, “Addendum No. 1” and inserting a date of February 16, 2018 on the lines provided for such on Page P-1 (General Bidders) or Page P-11 (Filed Sub-Bidders) as appropriate, of the Proposal Documents.

REVISE, in Specification section M-002-I, part 1.01, item B, which reads: B.
